key_insight: Uncertainty-guided simulation enrichment improves neural ensemble predictions for microdroplet generation and supports reliable inverse design.
engineering_relevance: The framework helps identify microfluidic configurations that meet target droplet sizes while reducing reliance on costly multiphase simulations.
method: Train neural network ensembles on high-fidelity Volume-of-Fluid simulations to predict flow regimes and droplet diameters.
Use regime consensus and diameter coefficient of variation to target additional simulations near uncertain transitions and address class imbalance.
Apply Particle Swarm Optimization for constrained inverse design, balancing accuracy, predictive confidence, and physical consistency.
evidence_signal: On independent test datasets, enrichment nearly doubled the fraction of diameter predictions with 0–3% error and substantially reduced cases above 10% error.
watch_item: Ensemble confidence may not guarantee accuracy outside the simulated design space; extrapolated designs warrant high-fidelity validation.
paper_title: Microdroplet Generator Surrogate Enhancement and Inverse Design Through an Uncertainty-Guided Framework
